svg.aria-label: Bachelor's thesis at OTH Amberg-Weiden, grade 1.3, mention Excellent: a cognitive verification layer for elderly-care robots. Seven LangGraph agents check each smart-home sensor alarm against the patient's own history and a camera image, then a deterministic guardrail approves any action by the Pepper robot or alert to a caregiver. 96.8% routing accuracy, rule-based baseline 46.0%; 60.3% → 1.6% false-positive escalations, ~37x fewer; 0 emergencies missed across 63 labelled cases. Synthetic, pilot-scale evaluation.
